documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with revenues from operations at Rs. 70,507.54 lakhs and PAT at Rs. 2,024.52 lakhs. Management highlighted ongoing corporate restructuring involving the amalgamation of Bhagyanagar Copper Private Limited (BCPL) and demerger of the copper business into Tieramet Ltd. The company is executing a preferential issue to raise Rs.

guidance.claim: Management targets doubling the turnover of the copper business to 5,000 crores in the year 2030, translating to a 25% CAGR over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum volume growth of 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year on an increased top line.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: For the upcoming year, management expects 20% volume growth and a 5% increase in prices out of their total projected growth.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management plans to increase the share of value-added products up to 66% by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

demand_outlook.claim: Global copper consumption is predicted to double from 26 million tonnes to 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposed a capex of 40 crores in the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with a new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, reaching around 62 rupees per kg in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards. With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Silver and tin-bearing bus bars for AI and other data centers will give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins. And this go for AI data centers and other data centers all over the world.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume grew by 34% last year from around 18,000 metric tonnes to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The total fund raise through preferential allotment is Rs. 52.25 Crores.
Total equity increased from 193 crores to 207 crores and further to 257 crores through retained earnings without equity dilution.
capital_allocation.quote: And then from 207 to 257. And this increase in equity was not done through dilution, this was all done through retained earnings.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital increased from 157 crores to 230 crores, which management stated is proportional to revenue growth.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores. And this increase in working capital is proportional to our revenue, so there's no, no reason to be concerned.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that the company's exposure to the U.S. is 35%, which is the highest for a single country.
risks_headwinds.quote: And just because you've asked this question, I think I might as well say that our exposure to U.S. is 35%, which is the highest for a single country.

management_commitments.claim: The government mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content starting from FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Government has mandated that all new products made from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content (starting from FY28)

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in turnover for the demerged copper company in the year 2030.
management_commitments.quote: We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve a 25% CAGR target for the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale up the value-added product mix up to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: Lead recycling has been dropped from plans for at least the next one to one and a half years.
management_commitments.quote: Lead recycling, for the time being, we have dropped it. At least for the next one, one and a half years, we are not looking at lead.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
